detail.title: Robustness and Redundancy in Quantum and Classical Records
detail.summary: Robustness of physical records relies on environmental redundancy and error tolerance under noise, permitting independent observers to retrieve consistent states.
detail.reason: Revising nb-record-robustness-01 with new supporting evidence and rigorous claim validation.

detail.title: Operational Frameworks for Objective Records
detail.summary: Objective physical records emerge through environmental redundancy, einselection, and broadcast structures that allow multiple independent observers to access consistent information without disturbing the source system.
detail.reason: Revising the objective records notebook with expanded collected evidence from quantum-to-classical transition literature.
